verdict.rationale: Maritime's docs say any Docker image that implements a three-endpoint contract becomes a fully managed agent. Repos with a Dockerfile, including private GitHub repos, are built and run on the platform. Publishers can also create cloneable templates and share them by link or through a public library, which covers both halves of the story (BYO image and custom templates). Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration, and thin documentation of the three-endpoint contract and of how custom templates are authored.
